decision: retain gauged_spatial_4000 as one generic physical-inspired development challenger and open resolution/tiling invariance; keep the production default unchanged
interpretation: The reused data-independent neutral-axis gauge removes the rejected channel cast while retaining paper-like dynamic-range compression. The corrected 4000-dpi spatial chain is repeat-exact, severe-clean on nine full-resolution images and narrowly preferred in two of three autonomous blind rounds. The margin is small, so it is challenger evidence rather than a product or authenticity promotion.

claim_ceiling: generic physical-inspired mechanism and autonomous development preference evidence; not population preference, stock response, measured print/scanner response, calibration or product promotion
